description: Confirmed windows for Silver. Titanium has no separate confirmed state, so this returns no Titanium rows.
sql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
  CAST(s.stage_num AS TEXT) AS window_label,
  CAST(s.confirmed_start_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_ts,
  CAST(s.confirmed_end_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_ts,
  '#60A5FA' AS color,
  CAST(COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS sample_count
FROM featurestore:nextier_copper_stage_index_v1 s
WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(:stage_model AS TEXT), ''), 'silver') <> 'titanium'
  AND s.well_name = :well_name
  AND s.stage_num IS NOT NULL
  AND s.continuous_start_ts IS NULL AND s.continuous_end_ts IS NULL AND s.confirmed_start_ts IS NOT NULL AND s.confirmed_end_ts IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(s.confirmed_start_ts AS TIMESTAMP) <= CAST(:end_time AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND CAST(s.confirmed_end_ts AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST(:start_time AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND CAST(s.confirmed_start_ts AS TIMESTAMP) <= CAST(s.confirmed_end_ts AS TIMESTAMP)
) q
ORDER BY start_ts, CAST(window_label AS DOUBLE PRECISION)
